column3: Only expands availability of existing M8g instances to four regions; processor and size descriptions are background.
Extends existing certificate-based authentication to Windows multi-session fleets as an authentication compatibility option.
Adds P6-B200 hardware to existing SageMaker notebook environments, with increased GPU memory and performance.
Adds approval policies governing existing asset-sharing operations, scoped by asset type and approver group.
Adds key encapsulation and decapsulation to establish a shared secret using ML-KEM, distinct cryptographic operations beyond an algorithm parameter.
Database-level ACLs and atomic or cluster-wide variants of existing key/hash operations extend controls and operation options; throughput gains alone are level 1.
GA announcement describes automatic quota monitoring and notifications but does not identify a substantive change from any pre-GA capability.
Alongside a routine model addition, tool search introduces discovering tools from large libraries through the Bedrock API.
GA description explains the Cognito Identity Pools L2 construct but states no substantive change relative to its pre-GA version.
Adds Java 21 as a canary runtime within existing synthetic monitoring; packaging, metrics and tracing support accompany that runtime.
Asset partitioning adds scheduling granularity and HITL, callbacks and async callable support extend existing workflow controls and compatibility.
Adds private endpoint connectivity to the existing SCEP certificate-request operation.
HIPAA eligibility changes compliance status without an announced product capability change.
Describes the GA Query Studio workspace and visualization features without establishing which capabilities changed from preview.
Launches a community and learning portal with articles, courses, events and feedback rather than a cloud product capability.
Adds visibility of managed dedicated IPs and SNDS metrics through existing SES and CloudWatch interfaces.
Extends existing concurrency scaling to auto-copy ingestion, a new target for an existing scaling capability.
Claude Tag introduces a persistent shared channel-agent operating model with its own identity, remembered context and future task execution within Claude Enterprise.
Integrates GuardDuty scanning with AWS Backup to add automatic, on-demand and pre-restoration backup malware verification.
Supports shared Managed Active Directory across accounts for existing license subscriptions and management.
Makes existing I8ge instances available in Ireland; performance descriptions do not announce another product change.
Kafka Queues introduce shared consumption of the same topic partitions for point-to-point processing, a new message-consumption model.
Adds India geography availability and India-confined cross-region profiles for existing OpenAI models and inference APIs.
Raises the maximum Aurora DSQL storage limit from 128 TiB to 256 TiB.
Expands existing Hpc8a instance availability to Tokyo and GovCloud US-West.
Adds larger WorkSpaces hardware bundles with 16 or 32 vCPUs and corresponding memory.
Expands availability of existing RDS database instance families to additional regions.
Adds per-table storage-cost detail to existing S3 Tables reporting in Cost Explorer and CUR.
GA announcement describes RHEL for AWS integrations and image mode but does not establish the substantive delta from any pre-GA offering.
Adds MySQL minor runtime versions with unspecified fixes and improvements to existing RDS database operation.
Expands existing S3 Access Grants to Thailand and Mexico regions.
